name: CiviMRF Core
description: Drupal-side abstraction for calling a remote (or local) CiviCRM instance's APIv3/APIv4 over REST, via configurable connection profiles and connectors.
project_description: CMRF is the CiviCRM Modular Remote-access Framework ("CiviMRF"). This module handles the Drupal 8+ integration: it lets Drupal talk to a CiviCRM instance either remotely over CiviCRM's REST endpoint or locally through the in-process CiviCRM API. Calls are made through a Core service using configurable connection profiles (URL + site key + API key) and connectors, are persisted to a database call log, and can be cached. Submodules add Views sources (cmrf_views), Webform submission handling (cmrf_webform), a call report UI (cmrf_call_report), and an example client (cmrf_example).
